0E0ZOg7uUMEhQCQ8ziZu.titulo: AI Use before the Federal Tribunal for Conciliation and Arbitration (Ley Federal de los Trabajadores al Servicio del Estado [Federal Law for State Workers], arts. 123 Bis through 123 Quinquies)
0E0ZOg7uUMEhQCQ8ziZu.descripcion: Adds a Chapter I Bis to Title Seven of the Ley Federal de los Trabajadores al Servicio del Estado (Federal Law for State Workers) to regulate the use of AI tools in proceedings before the Federal Tribunal for Conciliation and Arbitration. Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for judicial decisions remains with the judges: AI cannot substitute for legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or make decisions without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives from Sen. Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (8-Jul-2026).

0VWUAantUHXLQWUs3yzs.titulo: Constitutional Reform: AI in the Administration of Justice (Article 17, CPEUM)
0VWUAantUHXLQWUs3yzs.descripcion: Adds a third paragraph to Article 17 of the Constitution—the constitutional anchor of the package: recognizes the use of AI tools in the administration of justice under principles of human oversight and transparency. Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for judicial decisions remains with the judges: AI cannot substitute for legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or render decisions without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives from Senator Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (July 8, 2026).

2cpKndFU2qEwDdwPDNcw.titulo: AI Use in Administrative Procedure (LFPA, arts. 18-A to 18-D)
2cpKndFU2qEwDdwPDNcw.descripcion: Adds a new First A Chapter to Title III of the Federal Law on Administrative Procedure (Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo) to regulate the use of AI tools in federal administrative proceedings. Subjects AI tool use to principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human supervision, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for decisions remains with the judicial decision-makers: AI cannot replace legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or decide without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 identical bills sponsored by Sen. Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (Jul. 8, 2026).

2szu6AAbyKwSTjMaPcXu.titulo: Use of AI in the juicio contencioso administrativo federal (LFPCA, arts. 7 Ter a 7 Sexies)
2szu6AAbyKwSTjMaPcXu.descripcion: Adds a Chapter I Bis to Title I of the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Contencioso Administrativo (Federal Law on Administrative Contentious Proceedings) to permit AI tools and other support technologies in the juicio contencioso administrativo federal (federal administrative contentious proceeding). Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for judicial decisions remains with the personas juzgadoras (judges): AI cannot replace legal reasoning, automatically evaluate evidence, or make decisions without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Senator Dorantes on AI in jurisdictional proceedings (July 8, 2026).

9PT5T8IX3hvV9II7Jpgj.titulo: Use of AI in electoral remedies (General Law of the Electoral Remedies System (LGSMIME), art. 6 Bis)
9PT5T8IX3hvV9II7Jpgj.descripcion: Adds Chapter I Bis to Title Two of the General Law of the Electoral Remedies System to regulate the use of AI tools in electoral remedies (medios de impugnación). Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for rulings remains with the judges: AI cannot substitute for legal reasoning, automatically weigh evidence, or decide without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Sen. Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (July 8, 2026).

AJeFZYfzxJPCnPjOpnrs.titulo: Algorithmic Transparency in the Legislative Process (Reglamento del Senado — Senate Regulations)
AJeFZYfzxJPCnPjOpnrs.descripcion: Amends articles 169 and 190 and adds article 277 Bis to the Reglamento del Senado (Senate Regulations) to promote transparency in the use of AI in legislative functions: no significant AI intervention in the formation of any legislative product shall remain hidden from the public.

B5BHYMdQyXGMahxgmLmY.titulo: Use of AI in Criminal Procedure (Código Nacional de Procedimientos Penales, articles 14 Bis through 14 Quinquies)
B5BHYMdQyXGMahxgmLmY.descripcion: Adds Chapter I Bis to Title II "Principles and Rights in Procedure" of the Código Nacional de Procedimientos Penales (National Code of Criminal Procedure) to regulate the use of AI tools in criminal procedure. Conditions AI tool use on principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Judicial responsibility remains with judges: AI cannot substitute for legal reasoning, automatically evaluate evidence, or render decisions without human intervention. Part of Senator Dorantes' package of 14 mirror initiatives on AI in judicial proceedings (July 8, 2026).

BpIT8bjQwE3WKUHqSNHF.titulo: Use of AI in Labor Proceedings (Ley Federal del Trabajo [Federal Labor Law], arts. 688 Bis to 688 Quinquies)
BpIT8bjQwE3WKUHqSNHF.descripcion: Adds Chapter I Bis to Title Fourteen "Derecho Procesal del Trabajo" (Labor Procedural Law) of the Ley Federal del Trabajo (Federal Labor Law) to regulate the use of AI tools in labor proceedings. Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for rulings remains with the judges (personas juzgadoras): AI cannot replace legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or make decisions without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Senator Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (8-jul-2026).

C9xNfZE3IL6SjyPJshfe.titulo: Use of AI in military criminal proceedings (Código Militar de Procedimientos Penales (Military Criminal Procedure Code))
C9xNfZE3IL6SjyPJshfe.descripcion: Adds Chapter I Bis to Title II of the Código Militar de Procedimientos Penales (Military Criminal Procedure Code) (articles 14 Bis through 14 Quinquies) to regulate the use of AI tools in military criminal justice. Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for judicial decisions remains with judges: AI cannot replace legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or decide without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Senator Dorantes on AI in jurisdictional proceedings (July 8, 2026).

CH443RQGqmzucsIenNQT.titulo: Use of AI in Commercial Trials (Código de Comercio (Commercial Code), arts. 1055 Ter to 1055 Sexies)
CH443RQGqmzucsIenNQT.descripcion: Adds Chapter I Bis to Book Five "On Commercial Trials" of the Código de Comercio (Commercial Code) to regulate the use of AI tools in commercial trials. Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human supervision, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. The responsibility for rulings remains with the judges: AI cannot substitute legal reasoning, assess evidence automatically, or decide without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Senator Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (July 8, 2026).

mPQpbBSUWzqK1B8DNZ8Y.titulo: Use of AI in Civil and Family Procedures (CNPCyF)
mPQpbBSUWzqK1B8DNZ8Y.descripcion: Adds a Section Primera Bis (new section) to the Código Nacional de Procedimientos Civiles y Familiares (National Civil and Family Procedure Code) to regulate the use of AI tools in the civil and family justice system (impartición de justicia). Subjects AI tool usage to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for rulings (resoluciones) remains with judicial officers (personas juzgadoras): AI cannot replace legal reasoning, automatically evaluate evidence, or make decisions without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Sen. Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (8-Jul-2026).

rSdf46SNaLlLheZHFfq9.titulo: Use of AI in administrative responsibility proceedings (LGRA)
rSdf46SNaLlLheZHFfq9.descripcion: Adds a Third Title to the Second Book of the General Law on Administrative Responsibilities (Ley General de Responsabilidades Administrativas - LGRA) regarding the use of AI tools in the investigation and qualification of serious and non-serious offenses and in administrative responsibility proceedings. Subjects the use of AI tools to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality and information security. Responsibility for judicial decisions remains with judges: AI cannot substitute judicial reasoning, automatically evaluate evidence, or decide without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Sen. Dorantes on AI in jurisdictional proceedings (July 8, 2026).

vHgt1RwkWQ3Ut7AxOzFQ.titulo: Use of AI in Agrarian Justice (Ley Agraria (Mexican Agrarian Law), arts. 169 Bis to 169 Quinquies)
vHgt1RwkWQ3Ut7AxOzFQ.descripcion: Adds a Chapter I Bis to Title X "On Agrarian Justice" of the Ley Agraria (Mexican Agrarian Law) to regulate the use of AI tools in agrarian disputes (juicios agrarios). Subjects the use of AI tools to principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Judicial responsibility remains with judges (personas juzgadoras): AI cannot substitute for legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or render decisions without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives by Sen. Dorantes on AI in judicial proceedings (procedimientos jurisdiccionales) (July 8, 2026).

zTC5BhxbkXPU3T56bXxx.titulo: Use of AI in the amparo (Ley de Amparo, arts. 4 Bis–4 Quinquies)
zTC5BhxbkXPU3T56bXxx.descripcion: Adds a Chapter I Bis "On the Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools" to the Ley de Amparo, allowing AI in the amparo (Mexican constitutional relief proceeding) with respect to procedural principles, the human rights of litigants, and judicial transparency. Includes a record of AI use to be issued by the Órgano de Administración Judicial (Judicial Administration Authority). Subjects AI tool use to the principles of legality, transparency, traceability, human oversight, explainability, personal data protection, non-discrimination, accountability, proportionality, and information security. Responsibility for judicial decisions remains with judges: AI cannot replace legal reasoning, automatically assess evidence, or decide without human intervention. Part of a package of 14 mirror initiatives from Sen. Dorantes on AI in jurisdictional proceedings (8-Jul-2026).

rC2srhky6dMn6CzEPniQ.titulo: Ley General para la Regulación y Uso Ético de la Inteligencia Artificial (General Law for the Regulation and Ethical Use of Artificial Intelligence)
rC2srhky6dMn6CzEPniQ.descripcion: Draft legislation to establish a General Artificial Intelligence Law with broad application across all three branches of government and private companies and individuals engaged in AI development or commercialization within the country. Creates the Agencia Nacional de Supervisión de la Inteligencia Artificial (National Agency for Supervising Artificial Intelligence), an autonomous public body empowered to verify, audit, and impose sanctions, and the Registro Nacional de Sistemas de IA de Alto Riesgo (National Registry of High-Risk AI Systems), requiring transparency and disclosure of algorithms deployed in critical sectors: healthcare (diagnostic and triage systems), education, employment (recruitment, retention, and termination decisions), public security (predictive policing), justice, and essential services (credit and insurance). Prohibits behavioral manipulation, mass surveillance without court order, generalized social scoring, and synthetic media deepfakes used for fraud or violence. Establishes tiered penalties—minor, serious, and severe—including permanent system suspension for violations, and mandates impact assessments and audit requirements in government AI acquisitions.

6NR8qlVcA80WJ96bwSbz.titulo: CDMX Código Penal (Penal Code) Reforms on Identity Usurpation via Artificial Intelligence
6NR8qlVcA80WJ96bwSbz.descripcion: Unanimous reform package amending the CDMX Código Penal (Penal Code) with specific criminal penalties for identity usurpation through artificial intelligence, recognizing digital AI tools as threats to personal property and security, and establishing targeted sanctions for AI-enabled criminal activity

4wBtabyuztWfnOrhZv1o.titulo: Initiative to Reform the Ley Federal del Trabajo (Federal Labor Law) to Regulate the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Workplace
4wBtabyuztWfnOrhZv1o.descripcion: Initiative aimed at reforming Article 132 of the Ley Federal del Trabajo (Federal Labor Law) to establish clear limits on the use of AI systems in the workplace. It proposes that AI be used solely as supplementary support for human work, prohibits employment decisions based exclusively on automated processes, establishes transparency obligations for employers regarding AI use, and prevents discriminatory practices derived from algorithms. It also contemplates that the STPS (Secretary of Labor and Social Welfare) issue general guidelines within 180 days.

6RwDxidx8USKthd93wZM.titulo: Forthcoming Ley General para Regular y Fomentar el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (General Law to Regulate and Foster the Use of Artificial Intelligence)
6RwDxidx8USKthd93wZM.descripcion: Essential foundational regulatory framework for AI use in Mexico, designed to foster and regulate deployment of this technology alongside a national plan or strategy for its implementation. The proposal compiled systematized input from experts and technical documents.

rDbmoWNNTCufdOO3cY7c.titulo: Legislative Initiative to Reform the Ley Federal del Trabajo (Federal Labor Law) to Regulate the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Workplace
rDbmoWNNTCufdOO3cY7c.descripcion: Initiative to establish limits on the use of artificial intelligence systems in the workplace, especially regarding job displacement, digital surveillance, and automated labor decision-making, requiring companies to use AI as a complementary tool and not as a substitute for human employment.

YYNLxUtdx0Q0nAccndML.titulo: Ley General para Regular y Fomentar el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial en México - Versión Multipartidista del Senado (General Law to Regulate and Promote Artificial Intelligence in Mexico - Senate Multipartisan Version)
YYNLxUtdx0Q0nAccndML.descripcion: Mexico's first comprehensive artificial intelligence law that classifies violations into three levels (minor, serious, and severe), creates new national institutions, establishes the National Authority for Artificial Intelligence (Autoridad Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial), prohibits non-consensual sexual deepfakes and AI-driven electoral manipulation, and places special emphasis on the protection of women, children, and vulnerable groups. It includes provisions on neurorights (neuroderechos).

6iC4V3SESQk43Po6CV0I.titulo: Bill to amend Article 30, Section IV of the Ley General de Educación (General Education Law) on artificial intelligence
6iC4V3SESQk43Po6CV0I.descripcion: Initiative to incorporate responsible, ethical, and incremental use of artificial intelligence in education, acknowledging its impact on teaching and learning processes and the need for regulatory frameworks in the pedagogical domain.

N2tlm88NVa9QFzAJmDv5.titulo: Jucopo (Coordination Board) Agreement to Create Special Commission on Artificial Intelligence
N2tlm88NVa9QFzAJmDv5.descripcion: Creation of special commission comprising 9 deputies (3 from MORENA, 2 from PAN, 1 from PVEM, 1 from PT, 1 from PRI, 1 from MC) plus the president of the Comisión de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Commission on Science, Technology and Innovation), aimed at analyzing, monitoring and evaluating the development, implementation and impact of AI in Mexico to promote a comprehensive regulatory framework

NS2WBSsivlRrUGlfqhwp.titulo: Initiative with draft decree reforming Section IV of Article 30 of the Ley General de Educación (General Education Law) concerning artificial intelligence in education
NS2WBSsivlRrUGlfqhwp.descripcion: Proposes amending the Ley General de Educación (General Education Law) to include specific provisions regarding the use of artificial intelligence in educational processes, establishing criteria for its responsible and ethical pedagogical implementation in the national education system

LMfGhHDUUH6Zz5Q44FK8.titulo: Amendment to the General Education Law of the State of Mexico (Ley General de Educación del Estado de México) to Promote Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in Education
LMfGhHDUUH6Zz5Q44FK8.descripcion: Amendment approved by the State Congress (Congreso del Estado de México) for educational authorities to promote among teachers and students at upper secondary and tertiary levels the responsible, ethical, and gradual use of artificial intelligence for educational purposes.

avuW5cRAhltDcb5OQRjg.titulo: Reform to the Ley de Educación del Estado de México (Educational Law of the State of Mexico) to Promote Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in Education
avuW5cRAhltDcb5OQRjg.descripcion: Approved reform establishing that educational authorities must promote responsible, ethical, and gradual use of artificial intelligence for educational purposes among teaching staff and students at upper secondary and higher education levels, including necessary human and financial resources for its implementation

ecisQvm191ue63BllS1h.titulo: Reform to Article 61 of the Ley de Educación del Estado de México (Education Law of the State of Mexico) to promote the responsible, ethical, and gradual use of artificial intelligence for educational purposes at upper-secondary and university levels
ecisQvm191ue63BllS1h.descripcion: Initiative unanimously approved to reform the Ley de Educación del Estado de México (Education Law of the State of Mexico), establishing that educational authorities promote among teaching staff and students at upper-secondary and university levels the responsible, ethical, and gradual use of artificial intelligence for educational purposes, excluding basic education due to cognitive maturity requirements

hT2uaCs6YiPDXFUMl07x.titulo: Educational Reform Initiative to Promote Responsible AI Use in Upper-Secondary and Higher Education
hT2uaCs6YiPDXFUMl07x.descripcion: Initiative approved by the Congreso mexiquense (Congress of the State of Mexico) that requires educational authorities to encourage the responsible, ethical, and gradual use of artificial intelligence for educational purposes among teachers and students in upper-secondary and higher education.

2RsFA4lr8Aa0wlEiShdn.titulo: Ley General para Regular y Fomentar el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial en México (General Law to Regulate and Promote the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Mexico)
2RsFA4lr8Aa0wlEiShdn.descripcion: First comprehensive AI law in Mexico that classifies violations into three levels (minor, serious, and very serious), establishes penalties ranging from fines to imprisonment for deepfakes and electoral manipulation, creates a Autoridad Nacional de IA (National AI Authority), recognizes neurorights, prohibits the use of AI for cognitive and political manipulation, and envisions a Red Nacional de Estadística de Uso y Monitoreo de IA (National Network for AI Usage Statistics and Monitoring)

essCPTYG1ExHjcF3veLj.titulo: Punto de Acuerdo (Agreement Point) urging the Junta de Coordinación Política (Political Coordination Board) to create a Comisión Especial (Special Commission) aimed at designing and articulating a comprehensive regulatory framework for the enactment of the Ley Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (National Artificial Intelligence Law)
essCPTYG1ExHjcF3veLj.descripcion: Proposal to create a Comisión Especial in the Cámara de Diputados (Chamber of Deputies) tasked with designing and articulating a comprehensive regulatory framework for the enactment of a Ley Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial, with the goal of building a legal framework that allows harnessing AI's potential while mitigating its risks

sJXmix7xOsTVpybkgPob.titulo: Senate's First Artificial Intelligence Act - Comprehensive Multiparty Framework
sJXmix7xOsTVpybkgPob.descripcion: Historic legislative initiative that proposes Mexico's first comprehensive legal framework for AI following 10 months of multiparty collaborative work. Classifies violations into three levels (minor, serious, and most serious), creates new national institutions, and establishes criminal penalties for misuse of AI in elections, non-consensual sexual deepfakes, and autonomous lethal systems. Contemplates the creation of a National AI Authority, National AI Certification System, National AI Strategy, and National Fund for AI Development.

SrQngT4DImYJDohb82OE.titulo: Proposal to Add to the Documento Renuncias Recaudatorias (DRR) 2027 Taxpayers Investing in AI Development and Implementation
SrQngT4DImYJDohb82OE.descripcion: Punto de acuerdo (parliamentary agreement) requesting tax authorities to incorporate tax incentives for taxpayers investing in AI development and implementation, aimed at promoting Mexican technologies and accelerating their integration into industrial supply chains.

vyDbBsidbn2v8z0rtBSN.titulo: By punto de acuerdo (motion), requesting that tax authorities respectfully incorporate into the Documento Renuncias Recaudatorias (DRR) 2027 taxpayers who invest in the development and implementation of Artificial Intelligence
vyDbBsidbn2v8z0rtBSN.descripcion: Punto de acuerdo (motion) to request tax incentives for taxpayers who invest in the development and implementation of artificial intelligence, promoting technological innovation with tax benefits

qwnixJKAQ6qw0xhOnANr.titulo: Initiative proposing a draft decree to amend and supplement the Ley General de los Derechos de Niñas, Niños y Adolescentes (General Law on the Rights of Children and Adolescents) concerning protection from cyber violence and artificial intelligence
qwnixJKAQ6qw0xhOnANr.descripcion: Proposes reforms and amendments to the Ley General de los Derechos de Niñas, Niños y Adolescentes (General Law on the Rights of Children and Adolescents) to protect minors from digital cyber violence and artificial intelligence, establishing specific protective measures against AI systems that could harm children and adolescents

9m8yIXEPf3mQiAGLKkGQ.titulo: Package of 10 Initiatives on Artificial Intelligence and Protection of Women and Girls
9m8yIXEPf3mQiAGLKkGQ.descripcion: Comprehensive package that includes: 1) Constitutional reform of Article 73 to establish congressional authority over AI and cybersecurity; 2) Reform to the Ley General de Educación (General Education Law) to incorporate AI curriculum; 3) AI-enabled safe internet for minors; 4) Teacher training on AI; 5) Consumer protection from AI-facilitated fraud

17gGZKUthBCGsfxE8Pf5.titulo: Package of 10 Initiatives by Michel González on Artificial Intelligence and Protection of Women and Girls (including Constitutional Amendment to Article 73)
17gGZKUthBCGsfxE8Pf5.descripcion: Package of 10 initiatives focused on two areas: regulation of Artificial Intelligence and strengthening of rights and protection for women, girls, boys, and adolescents. Includes amendment to Article 73 of the Constitution to grant Congress authority to legislate on Artificial Intelligence and cybersecurity.

L9gkQ9mbICBDRNuROHkW.titulo: That reforms various provisions of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code), regarding sexual violence generated with artificial intelligence
L9gkQ9mbICBDRNuROHkW.descripcion: Initiative reforming provisions of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) to penalize sexual violence generated through the use of artificial intelligence, addressing the risks of AI in generating non-consensual sexual content

wMiI3XK8UJ1fAsXLZ3PN.titulo: Amendment to Article 199 Octies of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) on the Creation of Intimate Content via Artificial Intelligence
wMiI3XK8UJ1fAsXLZ3PN.descripcion: Initiative to add a third paragraph to Article 199 Octies of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) that would criminalize the use of artificial intelligence techniques, applications, or programs to create, manipulate, and distribute videos, audio recordings, images, and digital reproductions of intimate content from a person without their consent. It specifically targets sexually explicit deepfakes and digital violence against women.

t0bAwkXuQRSsmzfAanQU.titulo: Initiative for the Regulation of Artificial Intelligence of the State of Michoacán
t0bAwkXuQRSsmzfAanQU.descripcion: State-level initiative seeking to establish a legal framework for regulating AI use across various everyday sectors, from digital services to administrative processes. It includes principles of transparency, personal data protection, and human oversight, as well as the creation of a Consejo Estatal de Supervisión de IA (State Council for AI Oversight).

KkXm4wvb3ZJNd6MNTvJX.titulo: Amendment to and expansion of various provisions of the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law) and the Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (Federal Law for Personal Data Protection in Private Hands) regarding AI-altered images and deepfakes
KkXm4wvb3ZJNd6MNTvJX.descripcion: Comprehensive initiative that proposes amending and expanding provisions in both the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law) and the Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (Federal Law for Personal Data Protection in Private Hands) to specifically regulate AI-altered images and deepfakes, addressing both intellectual property and personal data protection aspects.

mPmFSwoIRzNqouiSwHvo.titulo: Amendment to Article 73 of the Political Constitution of the United Mexican States (Mexican Constitution) regarding artificial intelligence
mPmFSwoIRzNqouiSwHvo.descripcion: Initiative proposing to amend Article 73 of the Political Constitution of the United Mexican States to authorize the Congress of the Union (legislative branch) to legislate on matters of artificial intelligence, establishing the constitutional foundations for comprehensive regulation of this technology in the country.

nWAYaNlXkib3Eg7uhu4m.titulo: That amend and add various provisions to the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law), and add provisions to the Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares (Federal Law for Personal Data Protection Held by Private Parties), regarding images altered with Artificial Intelligence or deepfakes
nWAYaNlXkib3Eg7uhu4m.descripcion: Initiative that seeks to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in the creation of synthetic content (deepfakes) by establishing protections in terms of copyright and personal data protection. It focuses on preventing malicious use of images altered by AI and establishes protection mechanisms for deepfake victims.

Iv7AZwaAfmoxcfTUyTnZ.titulo: That reforms and adds various provisions of the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law), in the matter of artificial intelligence
Iv7AZwaAfmoxcfTUyTnZ.descripcion: Initiative to update the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law) to address challenges posed by artificial intelligence in intellectual property matters, including protection for works created with AI assistance and establishing limits on purely automated creations

RryBOZOgBQdNwzWbZuOm.titulo: That amends articles 199 Septies, 199 Octies and 202 of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) regarding misuse of artificial intelligence
RryBOZOgBQdNwzWbZuOm.descripcion: Initiative to amend various articles of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to incorporate improper use of artificial intelligence as an aggravating factor in crimes violating sexual privacy and other offenses, including the criminalization of producing material through artificial intelligence tools

ksF3opuruKvbBlna1TWv.titulo: Amendments to Title Nine; Adds Chapter III and Article 211 Bis 8 to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) on artificial intelligence misuse and related technologies
ksF3opuruKvbBlna1TWv.descripcion: Bill proposing a new chapter within the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) dedicated to artificial intelligence misuse and analogous technologies, establishing specific criminal penalties to regulate improper use of these technologies

omnfErN4xGtOT1UcYvqe.titulo: Reform to Articles 199 Octies and 211 Bis 1 of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code), regarding altered images using artificial intelligence or deepfakes
omnfErN4xGtOT1UcYvqe.descripcion: Initiative that proposes to reform Articles 199 Octies and 211 Bis 1 of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) to include specific provisions regarding the misuse of images altered with artificial intelligence or deepfakes, establishing specific penalties for these emerging crimes.

phKXGwioQDI252wtkANU.titulo: That amends the first paragraph of articles 199 Septies and 199 Octies, and the final paragraph of article 202 of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code), concerning the improper use of Artificial Intelligence
phKXGwioQDI252wtkANU.descripcion: Initiative that amends various provisions of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) to address the improper use of artificial intelligence in sensitive areas such as schools and professional life. The proposal seeks to update the criminal legal framework to include specific penalties related to AI misuse, particularly in contexts that may generate risks and ethical concerns.

kKC71HzDUKSCpydgAO8v.titulo: Initiative of the Ley General de Inteligencia Artificial (General Artificial Intelligence Law) (Senado)
kKC71HzDUKSCpydgAO8v.descripcion: Initiative under development by the Comisión del Senado (Senate Commission) for Analysis, Monitoring and Evaluation on the Application and Development of Artificial Intelligence in Mexico. Seeks to be flexible legislation that addresses risk factors, establishes mandatory technical standards, ensures transparency regarding the data used to train models, clarifies how algorithms function, and fosters national innovation.

QPDN8zqfGzMuoRdNhoeL.titulo: That adds Article 77 Bis to the Ley General de los Derechos de Niñas, Niños y Adolescentes (General Law for the Rights of Children and Adolescents), regarding synthetic content generated through artificial intelligence
QPDN8zqfGzMuoRdNhoeL.descripcion: Initiative that proposes to add Article 77 Bis to the Ley General de los Derechos de Niñas, Niños y Adolescentes (General Law for the Rights of Children and Adolescents) to regulate and protect minors against synthetic content generated through artificial intelligence that could affect their comprehensive development and well-being.

o9UlOUoVOaoFDkAG3942.titulo: Reform of Article 199 Octies of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) regarding parental control, prevention, and sanctions for sexual privacy crimes committed through artificial intelligence programs or platforms
o9UlOUoVOaoFDkAG3942.descripcion: Amendment to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to punish sexual privacy crimes committed through artificial intelligence programs or platforms, with emphasis on parental control and prevention of technology-enabled gender-based violence.

owmG7b99CzLLjk2bvwPR.titulo: Initiative with draft decree through which fourth and fifth paragraphs are added to article 202 of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code)
owmG7b99CzLLjk2bvwPR.descripcion: Amendment to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to penalize conduct related to the misuse of artificial intelligence in the creation and dissemination of non-consensual sexual content and artificially-generated child sexual abuse material, in light of rapid technological development and the increasing use of AI across multiple sectors.

37P2biIy5SA0T455xTyn.titulo: Punto de acuerdo (legislative agreement point) requesting the Secretariado Ejecutivo del SNSP (Executive Secretariat of the National Public Safety System) and INEGI (National Institute of Statistics and Geography) to incorporate and systematize information related to the use of artificial intelligence in the commission of crimes
37P2biIy5SA0T455xTyn.descripcion: Punto de acuerdo (legislative agreement point) requesting the Secretariado Ejecutivo del Sistema Nacional de Seguridad Pública (Executive Secretariat of the National Public Safety System) and INEGI (National Institute of Statistics and Geography) to incorporate and systematize information related to the use of artificial intelligence in the commission of crimes, with the aim of strengthening the design of public policies regarding the prevention of cybercrime and digital violence.

D8PK8YXP29zS4rQrnv76.titulo: Punto de Acuerdo (Agreement Point) to urge local legislatures to criminalize sexual offenses involving artificial intelligence
D8PK8YXP29zS4rQrnv76.descripcion: Punto de Acuerdo (Agreement Point) urging the legislatures of the federated states to criminalize sexual conduct committed through the use of artificial intelligence, including the generation of fabricated intimate content.

FcVDtQhYQ80Vy12sWpCi.titulo: Punto de Acuerdo (Motion) on Systematization of Information on AI in Crimes
FcVDtQhYQ80Vy12sWpCi.descripcion: Punto de Acuerdo (Motion) to request the Secretariado Ejecutivo del Sistema Nacional de Seguridad Publica (SNSP – Executive Secretariat of the National Public Security System) and INEGI to assess the incorporation and systematization of information related to the use of artificial intelligence in the commission of crimes, in order to strengthen public policies for cybercrime prevention and digital violence.

NmQTXSHKuKxM1Id4QSuv.titulo: Initiative to Reform the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) on Digital Violence with AI
NmQTXSHKuKxM1Id4QSuv.descripcion: Initiative that reforms and adds various provisions of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to sanction the use of artificial intelligence in the creation and dissemination of false intimate sexual content (deepfakes), establishing specific penalties for these crimes.

VS4epLMRVHiJFuK8Zjd1.titulo: Initiative on aggravating factors for AI use in the commission of crimes
VS4epLMRVHiJFuK8Zjd1.descripcion: Initiative that amends various provisions of the Codigo Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to establish aggravating factors in the commission of crimes when artificial intelligence is used as a tool for their perpetration.

gZJzgCeWJJ1j7os28EjA.titulo: Constitutional reform initiative on digital ecosystems and artificial intelligence
gZJzgCeWJJ1j7os28EjA.descripcion: Initiative that reforms various articles of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Political Constitution of the United Mexican States) regarding recognition of digital ecosystems and artificial intelligence, seeking to establish a constitutional framework for technological governance.

y9kxeZCntvR7puwuFMoe.titulo: Initiative to Reform Article 6 of the Constitution on Artificial Intelligence
y9kxeZCntvR7puwuFMoe.descripcion: Initiative that amends the third paragraph of Article 6 of the Political Constitution of the United Mexican States to guarantee the right to access information and communication technologies, artificial intelligence, as well as broadcasting and telecommunications services as part of fundamental information and technology rights.

zgnyzmpjLhebsnvnnY2M.titulo: Reform to Article 6, third paragraph, of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Mexico's Political Constitution), concerning artificial intelligence
zgnyzmpjLhebsnvnnY2M.descripcion: Constitutional reform initiative proposing amendments to the third paragraph of Article 6 of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Mexico's Political Constitution) to incorporate provisions on artificial intelligence. The initiative acknowledges that technological development has fundamentally transformed how citizens access information and exercise their fundamental rights, emphasizing that AI is no longer a future promise but a living, autonomous, and evolving reality that demands constitutional recognition.

7262zlcG3LPSiTN8XFu8.titulo: Federal Initiative to Regulate Artificial Intelligence
7262zlcG3LPSiTN8XFu8.descripcion: Regulatory framework to develop, implement, and responsibly oversee AI in Mexico. Defines AI systems, sectoral applications, obligations and responsibilities for developers and users. Includes risk classification and creation of a specialized authority.

L8bjv1nEsQH301jxvAg0.titulo: Initiative to Protect Voice Dubbing Actors Against Unauthorized Use of Their Voices by Artificial Intelligence
L8bjv1nEsQH301jxvAg0.descripcion: Government initiative aimed at protecting voice dubbing actors from unauthorized use of their voices by Artificial Intelligence, described as the first initiative that would provide protection to workers without formal employment contracts, focusing on protecting the main work tool which is their voice

Ufi5VXVdFB1IHQBjrz1L.titulo: Legislative Initiative on Artificial Intelligence and Personal Data Processing by Public Entities in Mexico City (INFO CDMX)
Ufi5VXVdFB1IHQBjrz1L.descripcion: Initiative submitted by the Instituto de Transparencia, Acceso a la Información Pública, Protección de Datos Personales y Rendición de Cuentas de la Ciudad de México (Mexico City Institute for Transparency, Public Information Access, Personal Data Protection, and Accountability) to regulate artificial intelligence and personal data processing by public entities in Mexico City, pioneering the establishment of rules and procedures in this field.

H7LKKPoDqAPEMMgtCScH.titulo: Ley Nacional para Regular el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (National Law to Regulate the Use of Artificial Intelligence) (Senate)
H7LKKPoDqAPEMMgtCScH.descripcion: Comprehensive national law to regulate and control the use of AI in public and private sectors, creating the Agencia Reguladora del Desarrollo, Uso y Aplicación de la Inteligencia Artificial (Regulatory Agency for the Development, Use and Application of Artificial Intelligence) with broad regulatory authority, risk-level classification of systems, and sanctioning regime.

MUGozSaS0laqjTmFj026.titulo: Initiative with draft decree to enact the Ley Nacional para Regular el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (National Law to Regulate the Use of Artificial Intelligence)
MUGozSaS0laqjTmFj026.descripcion: Proposes to establish for the first time in Mexico a comprehensive legal framework applicable to the development, implementation, and use of artificial intelligence (AI) systems, both in the public and private sectors. Includes the creation of an Agencia Reguladora del Desarrollo, Uso y Aplicación de la Inteligencia Artificial (Regulatory Agency for the Development, Use, and Application of Artificial Intelligence), obligations for AI system providers, risk-level classification, and a sanctions regime with fines, suspensions, and disqualifications.

YVOm85qBCf0eSagXBgGC.titulo: Ley Nacional para Regular el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (National Law for Regulating the Use of Artificial Intelligence)
YVOm85qBCf0eSagXBgGC.descripcion: Initiative proposing to enact the Ley Nacional para Regular el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (National Law for Regulating the Use of Artificial Intelligence), establishing for the first time in Mexico a comprehensive legal framework applicable to the development, implementation, and use of AI systems in both the public and private sectors. Includes the creation of a Regulatory Agency for the Development, Use, and Application of Artificial Intelligence (Agencia Reguladora del Desarrollo, Uso y Aplicación de la Inteligencia Artificial) with broad regulatory powers to promote public policies, issue technical guidelines, classify systems by risk level, and address complaints. Imposes direct obligations on AI system providers including data management policies, risk analysis, and security measures.

zRc0Ydh60UM66bENUb42.titulo: Initiative for a National Law to Regulate the Use of Artificial Intelligence
zRc0Ydh60UM66bENUb42.descripcion: A public-order law of general application (Ley de orden público y observancia general) that seeks to regulate and control the use of AI in both public and private sectors, guaranteeing protection of human rights. It proposes the creation of a Regulatory Agency for the Development, Use, and Application of AI (Agencia Reguladora del Desarrollo, Uso y Aplicación de la IA) with broad regulatory powers and a comprehensive sanctions regime.

lqMENbXyrHBr9JI88cxd.titulo: AI Regulation to Combat Digital Violence and Deepfakes - Reform to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) and Ley de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia (Law on Women's Access to a Violence-Free Life)
lqMENbXyrHBr9JI88cxd.descripcion: Reform initiative to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) and the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia (General Law on Women's Access to a Violence-Free Life), aimed at sanctioning forms of gender-based violence generated through the misuse of artificial intelligence technologies. Explicitly recognizes the creation, manipulation, storage, and dissemination of false content (deepfakes) that sexualize, demean, or harm the dignity of real people without their consent as a serious form of violence. Updates the Ley Olimpia (Olympia Law) for the context of generative AI. If approved, Mexico would set a precedent by aligning its legislation with that of other nations such as the United Kingdom.

6PflDt92CLs8wdbxajFj.titulo: Amends Articles 5 and 20 Bis of the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencias (General Law for Women's Access to a Life Free of Violence), regarding political gender violence caused by artificial intelligence
6PflDt92CLs8wdbxajFj.descripcion: Initiative proposing to add Section XXI to Article 5 and amend the final paragraph of Article 20 Bis of the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia (General Law for Women's Access to a Life Free of Violence), to specifically include political gender violence caused by artificial intelligence as a recognized and sanctioned form of violence.

wQL1is56WTmNCXltFXYM.titulo: Initiative with a bill to add Section XXI to Article 5 and amend the final paragraph of Article 20 Bis of the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a Una Vida Libre de Violencia (General Law on Women's Right to a Life Free of Violence), regarding gender-based political violence caused by artificial intelligence
wQL1is56WTmNCXltFXYM.descripcion: Amends the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia (General Law on Women's Right to a Life Free of Violence) to specifically include gender-based political violence exercised through the use of artificial intelligence, such as the creation of deepfakes, image manipulation, or synthetic content to discredit women in public office or candidates.

URT1gxP6PUDDXdWxqjTP.titulo: Initiative to Add a Fourth Paragraph to Article 202 Ter of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) on Pornography Based on Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, or Social Status
URT1gxP6PUDDXdWxqjTP.descripcion: Proposes adding aggravated circumstances to the offense of pornography when artificial intelligence is used to create synthetic sexual content targeting LGBTTTIQ+ persons or vulnerable groups, recognizing new forms of digital violence and discrimination enabled by generative AI.

XRxnRquIjIqINO3W2eNC.titulo: Amending articles 202 and 202 Bis of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) regarding child pornography
XRxnRquIjIqINO3W2eNC.descripcion: Adds provisions to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to criminalize child pornography generated through artificial intelligence, addressing the emergence of generative AI and its risks to minors

bJkzb7aF5vyFh4vaDBEO.titulo: That amends articles 202 and 202 Bis of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) on child sexual abuse material
bJkzb7aF5vyFh4vaDBEO.descripcion: Amendment to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to specifically criminalize the creation, production, distribution, and commercialization of child sexual abuse material generated through artificial intelligence, recognizing the emerging risks posed by generative technologies.

w2VwoCVSH7EJuyDTa1Rn.titulo: Amending the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) to add Article 202 Ter regarding pornography based on sexual orientation, gender identity, or social status
w2VwoCVSH7EJuyDTa1Rn.descripcion: Initiative amending the Código Penal Federal (Federal Penal Code) to add a fourth paragraph to Article 202 Ter, penalizing the creation, distribution, or dissemination of sexually explicit images generated with artificial intelligence depicting LGBTTTIQ+ persons without their consent. Recognizes that AI-generated images constitute a critical form of digital violence disproportionately affecting vulnerable groups and aims to combat digital gender-based violence perpetrated through technological tools.

yxY6qgZ1naGvFSdsZAJp.titulo: That amends articles 202 and 202 Bis of the Código Penal Federal (Mexican Federal Penal Code), regarding child sexual abuse material
yxY6qgZ1naGvFSdsZAJp.descripcion: Initiative that reforms the Código Penal Federal (Mexican Federal Penal Code) to include specific provisions on child sexual abuse material generated with artificial intelligence. It recognizes that generative AI has marked an evolutionary milestone in the digital era with unprecedented realism capacity, creating new risks for minors. The proposal seeks to update criminal legislation to specifically address the use of AI tools in the creation of sexual content involving minors.

5mLFmZLApqPrQ1XJcuqK.titulo: Ley General para el Uso y Control de la Inteligencia Artificial en los Sectores Público y Privado (General Law for the Use and Control of Artificial Intelligence in Public and Private Sectors)
5mLFmZLApqPrQ1XJcuqK.descripcion: Legislative initiative with a bill to issue the Ley General para el Uso y Control de la Inteligencia Artificial en los Sectores Público y Privado (General Law for the Use and Control of Artificial Intelligence in Public and Private Sectors). Proposes creating a comprehensive law to regulate AI use in Mexico, in both the public and private sectors. Covers areas including education (AI training at all levels), labor (workplace adaptation), environment (limits on water consumption for cooling AI data centers and carbon footprint reduction), intellectual property (regulating use of third-party art in AI models), health (AI-assisted diagnosis in public hospitals), and military and judicial sectors. It is the first initiative in Mexico to explicitly address the environmental impact of AI.

KKO4Fa6OlioHNDjnav8V.titulo: Constitutional amendment to Article 73 to empower Congress in AI matters (Senate - Karina Ruiz)
KKO4Fa6OlioHNDjnav8V.descripcion: Bill with a draft decree amending Article 73 of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Political Constitution of the United Mexican States) to grant Congress the power to enact legislation on artificial intelligence. Proposes adding a new subsection to Article 73 of the constitution to give Congress exclusive authority to legislate on AI at the federal level, preventing regulatory fragmentation across states. Grounds this in the need to establish controls based on three pillars: ethics and transparency, personal data protection and privacy, and AI systems oversight with accountability. Referred to the Comisión de Puntos Constitucionales (Constitutional Points Commission), Comisión de Análisis, Seguimiento y Evaluación sobre la aplicación y desarrollo de la Inteligencia Artificial en México (Commission on Analysis, Monitoring and Evaluation of AI Application and Development), and Comisión de Estudios Legislativos del Senado (Legislative Studies Commission).

GAovr687STVjXS7lAVLj.titulo: Exhorto (legislative exhortation) from the Congreso de Coahuila (Coahuila State Congress) to the Congreso de la Unión (National Congress) to promote a comprehensive regulatory framework for artificial intelligence
GAovr687STVjXS7lAVLj.descripcion: Agreement approved by the Permanent Commission (Diputación Permanente) of the Congreso del Estado de Coahuila (Coahuila State Congress) that exhorts the Congreso de la Unión (National Congress) to promote and continue as a priority the legislative procedures necessary for the development of a comprehensive regulatory framework for artificial intelligence in Mexico. The exhorto (legislative exhortation) emphasizes the need to guarantee the protection of human rights, legal certainty, ethics and transparency in the development and use of these technologies, prioritizing an open parliament process with civic, academic and scientific participation.

gTdYKn6ZsoyRaJHaeZ3E.titulo: Legislative initiative with a bill to amend Article 199 Septies of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code), concerning the manipulation of images with artificial intelligence for sexual purposes
gTdYKn6ZsoyRaJHaeZ3E.descripcion: Initiative seeking to impose penalties of 4 to 8 years imprisonment and fines equal to 400 to 1,000 days of minimum wage on anyone who digitally manipulates images using AI to make them appear nude or involved in explicit sexual activities. It also covers the distribution, commercialization, and storage of such content.

iniciativa-ia-art73-20251217.titulo: That adds a section XXXIII to Article 73 of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Political Constitution of the United Mexican States), on artificial intelligence matters
iniciativa-ia-art73-20251217.descripcion: Initiative that proposes to empower the Congreso de la Unión (Mexican Congress) to issue laws on artificial intelligence, regulating the training systems employed by private parties that develop machine learning models intended to generate digital information for government agencies and the public. It is grounded in the need to establish controls based on three pillars: ethics and transparency, data protection, and oversight with accountability.

iniciativa-ia-cpp-20251217.titulo: That adds various provisions to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) regarding offenses committed using artificial intelligence systems
iniciativa-ia-cpp-20251217.descripcion: Initiative proposing to add Title Noveno Bis (Ninth Bis Section) to the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) to define and penalize offenses committed through artificial intelligence systems. Establishes definitions for AI System, Fraudulent Synthetic Content, and Responsible Human Agent; establishes the principle of human accountability; sets forth rules on authorship and participation; provides aggravating factors for use of AI in crimes against life, bodily integrity, property, and privacy; criminalizes obstruction of critical AI systems and unlawful commercialization of malicious AI systems.

OsSKtMiq3EWsM6onuoSd.titulo: Initiative to reform section XVII of article 73 of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Political Constitution of the United Mexican States) to authorize Congress of the Union to regulate artificial intelligence and technological devices
OsSKtMiq3EWsM6onuoSd.descripcion: Constitutional reform aimed at authorizing Congress of the Union to enact laws regulating, establishing requirements and limitations, operations, principles, and foundations for the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and all types of related technological devices, as well as to issue the necessary legislation to make these authorities effective

iniciativa-84.titulo: Reform to the Código Penal de Oaxaca (Oaxaca Penal Code) - Chapter X 'Artificial Intelligence' (4-8 years)
iniciativa-84.descripcion: Historic reform to the Código Penal de Oaxaca (Oaxaca Penal Code) approved by the LXVI Legislatura (66th Legislature) on December 2, 2025. Oaxaca becomes one of the first Mexican states to add a specific chapter on AI (Chapter X 'Artificial Intelligence') within Title Four 'Complementary Punishments'. Creates Article 72 Bis establishing sentence enhancements when AI is used as the means of commission in any crime codified in the law. Adds a fourth paragraph to Article 249 (Crimes Against Sexual Intimacy) sanctioning those who use AI to create or distribute intimate manipulated content without consent through deepfakes, false images, audio, or video. Penalties: 4 to 8 years in prison plus fines of 1,000 to 2,000 UMA (approximately 115,000 to 230,000 pesos). Ex officio prosecution. Sanctions exposure, distribution, exhibition, reproduction, transmission, commercialization, or exchange by any technological means. Approved with 31 votes in ordinary session. Represents a pioneering structural approach by creating a chapter dedicated exclusively to AI in Mexican state criminal law.

iniciativa-90.titulo: State AI Law Bill Initiative in Chihuahua (in committees)
iniciativa-90.descripcion: Legislative process underway to enact Mexico's First Comprehensive State AI Law (not a criminal law reform). Initiated in December 2025 by the Commission on Science and Technology of the Chihuahua State Congress, led by State Deputy Carla Rivas. Includes establishment of a State AI Council and formation of a multisectoral technical working group for public consultation. Committee vote expected in 2026. The State Government, through the Innovation Secretariat (Secretaría de Innovación), is advancing a national AI agenda from Chihuahua. Comprehensive approach (not solely punitive): ethics, data protection, innovation promotion, human rights, and governance. If approved, it would be Mexico's first non-penal state law on AI, serving as a potential model for other states.

iniciativa-edomex-001.titulo: Reform to the Penal Code of the State of Mexico (Código Penal del Estado de México) - Intimate Deepfakes (up to 5 years imprisonment)
iniciativa-edomex-001.descripcion: Reform to the Penal Code of the State of Mexico (Código Penal del Estado de México) to penalize the creation and dissemination of intimate deepfakes. Penalizes the use of artificial intelligence to manipulate intimate sexual content without consent, creating false facts with real appearance for storage, distribution, or display through technological means. Penalties: up to 5 years imprisonment and a fine of 500 UMA (approximately 56,570 pesos). Defines AI as any application or technology capable of analyzing and altering graphic material. Approved by the LXII Legislature in December 2025. Promoted by deputies Elías Rescala Jiménez and Lilia Urbina Salazar.

iniciativa-89.titulo: Penal Code of Michoacán (Código Penal de Michoacán) Reform - Digital Violence, Cyberstalking, and AI-Generated Sexual Content
iniciativa-89.descripcion: Initiatives presented by Deputy Brissa Arroyo (2024-2025) to reform the Penal Code of Michoacán (Código Penal de Michoacán). Proposes to criminalize as offenses: (1) creation and distribution of AI-altered sexual images without consent, (2) digital violence where AI is used as a tool, (3) cyberstalking and media harassment involving AI use. The Michoacán State Congress approved comprehensive reforms against digital and media violence that recognize AI as a means of committing crimes in November 2025. Includes penalties for use of AI to generate sexual content without consent. Reform approved on November 19, 2025, criminalizing media violence, digital violence, cyberstalking, and use of AI in crimes.

b0ynjXg6TNLA8xGQ2du8.titulo: Bill with draft decree amending article 199 Octies of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) concerning parental control, prevention and prosecution of sexual privacy violations committed using artificial intelligence programs or platforms
b0ynjXg6TNLA8xGQ2du8.descripcion: Proposes amendments to the Código Penal Federal to establish parental controls and prevent and punish sexual privacy violations committed using artificial intelligence programs or platforms, as well as amendments to the Ley en Materia de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión (Telecommunications and Broadcasting Law) toward the same end

iniciativa-83.titulo: Código Penal de Querétaro (Querétaro Penal Code) Reform - Non-Consensual Intimate Images with AI (3-6 years imprisonment)
iniciativa-83.descripcion: Reform to the Código Penal de Querétaro (Querétaro Penal Code) to punish the manipulation of AI-generated images. Criminalizes the creation, distribution, or commercialization of intimate or sexual images without consent using artificial intelligence. Penalties: 3 to 6 years imprisonment. The initiative focuses on protecting women, adolescents, and girls. Approved with 25 votes in favor in November 2025. Framed in relation to the EU AI Act, which mandates human oversight, transparency, and disclosure requirements for generative AI.

iniciativa-64.titulo: Amendment to Articles 211 Bis 8 and Others of the Federal Penal Code (Código Penal Federal) - AI-generated stickers and memes
iniciativa-64.descripcion: Proposed initiative to amend the Federal Penal Code (Código Penal Federal) by adding Articles 211 Bis 8 and 211 Bis 9 to impose prison sentences of 3 to 6 years and fines of 300 to 600 days' wages on anyone who creates, manipulates, or distributes images, videos, audio, or digital content generated with AI without consent, for the purpose of ridiculing, harassing, or damaging a person's reputation

iniciativa-1765421263636-zannwk.titulo: LFPPI Reform - Technology Transfer, Patent Simplification, and Artificial Intelligence Regulation
iniciativa-1765421263636-zannwk.descripcion: Federal Executive initiative submitted by President Claudia Sheinbaum on September 15, 2025 before the Senado (Mexican Senate). Comprehensive reform of the Ley Federal de Protección a la Propiedad Industrial (Federal Law for Protection of Industrial Property) regarding Technology Transfer and Patent Process Simplification.

mPfguhxMkIdqbFARqgVp.titulo: Initiative with draft decree to add a paragraph to Section VI of Subsection B of Article 6 of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Mexican Constitution), regarding digital identity protection
mPfguhxMkIdqbFARqgVp.descripcion: Proposes a constitutional reform to expressly recognize the right to protection of digital identity, defined as the set of personal attributes susceptible to manipulation by artificial intelligence. It seeks to establish regulatory boundaries against the use of AI that affects personal representation, including deepfakes and identity impersonation.

iniciativa-68.titulo: Reform for Labeling and Protection Against AI-Generated Content
iniciativa-68.descripcion: Initiative to add Article 32 Bis to the Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor (Federal Consumer Protection Law) and Article 221 Bis to the Ley en Materia de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión (Telecommunications and Broadcasting Law), establishing the obligation to label AI-generated content and protect against digital identity impersonation

iniciativa-66.titulo: Constitutional reform to article 73 to grant Congress authority in artificial intelligence matters
iniciativa-66.descripcion: New constitutional reform proposal to grant Congress powers in artificial intelligence

iniciativa-65.titulo: Decree amending and supplementing various provisions of the Código Penal Federal (Federal Criminal Code) and the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law), regarding generative artificial intelligence
iniciativa-65.descripcion: Reform that penalizes the misuse of technological tools based on generative artificial intelligence, establishes sentences of 6 months to 4 years in prison, protects works created with AI assistance, and adjusts the definition of computer program to include systems created with the assistance of technological tools based on generative artificial intelligence

iniciativa-79.titulo: Ley Federal para el Desarrollo Ético, Soberano e Inclusivo de la Inteligencia Artificial (Federal Law for the Ethical, Sovereign, and Inclusive Development of Artificial Intelligence)
iniciativa-79.descripcion: Initiative to enact the Ley Federal para el Desarrollo Ético, Soberano e Inclusivo de la Inteligencia Artificial. Establishes a new legal framework for ethical AI in Mexico, with emphasis on human rights, sovereignty, and inclusion. Proposes: evaluate the social, economic, environmental, and cultural impact of AI in Mexico; promote its responsible development; create a Consejo Nacional de IA (National AI Council); design a Estrategia Nacional sobre IA (National Strategy on AI).

lJc4I53UR9MlyDzbfBE4.titulo: Dictamen (Opinion) on Digital Violence with Generative AI - Comisión de Igualdad de Género (Gender Equality Commission)
lJc4I53UR9MlyDzbfBE4.descripcion: Dictamen (Opinion) from the Comisión de Igualdad de Género (Gender Equality Commission) on the initiative to criminalize digital violence through the use of generative artificial intelligence. The original initiative was introduced by Deputy Annia Sarahi Gómez Cárdenas (PAN) on April 29, 2025, and the Dictamen (Opinion) was published for first reading (primera lectura) on February 17, 2026.

j3ESQX60HSWu8Ldh26c0.titulo: Decree Amending and Adding Various Provisions of the Ley Federal de Cinematografía (Federal Film Law), the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (Federal Copyright Law), and the Ley Federal del Trabajo (Federal Labor Law), on Measures for Protecting Dubbing Actors Against the Use of Artificial Intelligence
j3ESQX60HSWu8Ldh26c0.descripcion: Initiative aimed at protecting dubbing actors against the use of artificial intelligence and voice-cloning technologies in dubbing processes. Addresses challenges such as labor precarization, job loss, dehumanization of artistic work, and violation of intellectual property rights in the dubbing industry.

BWvGh8zbScrmNduFK4ib.titulo: Initiative with a bill to enact the Ley Federal para el Desarrollo Ético, Soberano e Inclusivo de la Inteligencia Artificial en México (Federal Law for the Ethical, Sovereign and Inclusive Development of Artificial Intelligence in Mexico)
BWvGh8zbScrmNduFK4ib.descripcion: Initiative proposing to create an innovative, ethical and profoundly human law that establishes a risk traffic light system, classifying AI technologies into minimum, limited, high and prohibited levels based on their potential impact. It promotes the development of sovereign technology with national talent, public innovation and social ethics.

iniciativa-87.titulo: Yucatán CP Initiative - Comprehensive Reform on Cybercrime and AI
iniciativa-87.descripcion: Comprehensive technical initiative presented on September 1, 2023 by Deputies Gaspar Armando Quintal Parra and Karla Reyna Franco Blanco (PRI). It proposes amendments to multiple articles of the Código Penal (Mexican Penal Code): Art. 243 Bis 3 (aggravated violation of sexual privacy using AI), Art. 243 Bis 4 (aggravated coercion or harassment using AI-generated material), new Art. 243 Bis 13 (improper use of AI software to create or manipulate images, videos or audio causing injury or damage), Art. 287 (aggravated making false statements before an authority using AI-created evidence). Includes technical definition of 'AI Software'. Amends the title of Chapter V TER to 'CYBERCRIME, CYBER OFFENSES AND IMPROPER USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE'.

iniciativa-86.titulo: Guanajuato Penal Code Initiative - Chain Liability for AI (+50% penalty increase)
iniciativa-86.descripcion: Comprehensive initiative to reform the Código Penal de Guanajuato (Guanajuato Penal Code) presented in February 2025 (Bulletin 9010 of 02/27/2025). Proposes increasing penalties by up to one-half (1/2) for crimes committed with AI, specifically: extortion, virtual kidnapping, fraud, and sexual offenses. Notable innovation: establishes 'responsabilidad en cadena' (chain liability) for those who design, program, use, commercialize, or maintain AI systems for criminal purposes. Includes liability for intentional or negligent harm caused by AI. Proposes creating a dedicated AI chapter in the Penal Code. Presented by deputy Alejandro Arias Ávila (PRI), referred to the Comisión de Justicia (Justice Commission).

3o1kfmtpPpKJKHr20t4B.titulo: Which amends Section XVII of Article 73 of the Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (Political Constitution of the United Mexican States) on matters of artificial intelligence
3o1kfmtpPpKJKHr20t4B.descripcion: An initiative that proposes to amend Section XVII of Article 73 of the Constitution to explicitly include artificial intelligence among the subject matters that the Congreso de la Unión (Congress of the Union) is empowered to legislate, with the aim of enabling it to enact a Ley General de Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (General Law for the Use of Artificial Intelligence). The initiative seeks to position Mexico as a regional leader in technological innovation applied to key economic sectors.

iniciativa-69.titulo: Constitutional amendment to Article 73 on artificial intelligence (Ricardo Monreal)
iniciativa-69.descripcion: Amends section XVII of Article 73 of the Constitution to explicitly grant Congress authority to legislate on artificial intelligence

iniciativa-88.titulo: Campeche CP Initiative - Digital Violence and Deepfakes with AI (Ley Olimpia (Olympia Law) + AI)
iniciativa-88.descripcion: Initiative INI078LXV0225 presented on February 11, 2025 by the Morena Parliamentary Group (16 deputies) in the LXV Legislature of the Campeche Congress. Amends Articles 175 Bis, 255, and 260 of the Código Penal de Campeche (Campeche Penal Code) to criminalize digital violence and AI-generated deepfakes within the framework of the Ley Olimpia (Olympia Law). Article 175 Bis: Imposes 3–6 years imprisonment plus a fine of 500–1,000 UMA for the creation or distribution of sexual or lascivious content generated using AI with facial data collection or reconstruction of physical features without consent. Article 255: Imposes 3 months to 2 years imprisonment for pornographic content created using AI from biometric data. Article 260: Imposes 5–10 years imprisonment plus a fine of 400–800 UMA for the production of child sexual abuse material using AI-based facial recognition. Sensity AI statistic: 90–95% of pornographic deepfakes affect women. Historic expansion of the Ley Olimpia (Olympia Law) to include deepfakes and AI-generated content.

Xmr1xurV9A6YIc9iK9AK.titulo: National Bill Initiative Regulating the Use of Artificial Intelligence
Xmr1xurV9A6YIc9iK9AK.descripcion: Bill initiative in preparation by the Comisión de Análisis, Seguimiento y Evaluación (Commission for Analysis, Monitoring, and Evaluation) on the application and development of AI in Mexico. It seeks to establish a flexible regulatory framework that addresses risk factors, mandatory technical standards, transparency regarding model training data, and clarity on algorithms used. It is expected to be ready in February 2025 to begin legislative procedures.

iniciativa-60.titulo: Reforma a Ley en Materia de Telecomunicaciones y Radiodifusión (Reform to the Telecommunications and Broadcasting Law) - Identification of AI-Generated Content
iniciativa-60.descripcion: Legal framework for identifying and making transparent the source of AI-generated digital content. Distinguishes between information produced by individuals and by automated systems. Incorporates legal definitions for an emerging category of information production.

iniciativa-59.titulo: National Law Regulating the Use of AI (Ley Nacional que regula el uso de la IA)
iniciativa-59.descripcion: Risk-based approach (similar to the EU). Creates Centro Nacional de IA (National AI Center) as the national policy coordinator. Principles: ethics, legality, transparency, open government, without social manipulation, nor ideological bias

iniciativa-63.descripcion: Ley del Uso de Inteligencia Artificial del Tratamiento de Datos Personales por Sujetos Obligados de la Ciudad de México (Law for the Use of Artificial Intelligence and Processing of Personal Data by Obligated Subjects of Mexico City). cTeIYafeBoBOCRhehYaD.titulo: Ley para el uso de inteligencia artificial y el tratamiento de datos personales por sujetos obligados en la Ciudad de México (Law for the Use of Artificial Intelligence and the Treatment of Personal Data by Obligated Entities in Mexico City)
cTeIYafeBoBOCRhehYaD.descripcion: One of the first law initiatives in Latin America specifically focused on regulating the use of AI by the public sector in the treatment of personal data. It establishes principles of ethics, security, and transparency. Includes algorithmic transparency, AI governance, algorithmic accountability, and risk management. Counts on the support of all parliamentary groups in the capital's Congress.

nBIAKZykJ2o88Qdov7Q8.descripcion: Initiative presented by INFO CDMX to specifically regulate the use of artificial intelligence by obligated subjects in Mexico City, establishing rules for the proper handling of personal data when AI systems are used in local government. 6Bk7MIEDkmbJZYF2dekF.titulo: Bill on Artificial Intelligence and Personal Data Processing for Obligated Subjects in Mexico City
6Bk7MIEDkmbJZYF2dekF.descripcion: Initiative that seeks to regulate the implementation of Artificial Intelligence for proper use and management of personal data for Mexico City residents. If approved, Mexico City would be a pioneer in Latin America in this area.

iniciativa-85.titulo: Quintana Roo Penal Code (Código Penal) Amendment - Article 20 Bis: General AI Aggravating Factor (+50% Sentence Enhancement)
iniciativa-85.descripcion: Amendment to the Penal Code of Quintana Roo (Código Penal de Quintana Roo) that adds Article 20 Bis (Artículo 20 Bis) as a general aggravating factor: increases sentences up to 1.5 times (by an additional 50%) for ANY crime committed using artificial intelligence. Model of a "general aggravating factor" versus specific criminal statutes, applicable to current and future offenses. Approved in April 2024, it was challenged through action of unconstitutionality (acción de inconstitucionalidad) 104/2024. The Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation (Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación, SCJN) upheld its constitutionality on April 28, 2025, establishing the first constitutional judicial precedent on AI regulation in Mexican criminal law. The SCJN (Pleno, April 28, 2025) dismissed 5-4 the action of unconstitutionality (acción de inconstitucionalidad) against Article 20 Bis; the provision survives and remains in force.

iniciativa-56.titulo: Reform to Articles 20 Ter and 20 Quáter of the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia (General Law on Women's Access to a Life Free of Violence)
iniciativa-56.descripcion: Legislative initiative presented by Deputy Julieta Kristal Vences Valencia (Morena) before the LXV Congress on February 18, 2025. Amends and adds to Articles 20 Ter and 20 Quáter of the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia to recognize and sanction 'sicariato digital' (digital hired violence) as a new form of digital violence. Defines as digital violence any action involving the manipulation, alteration, or distribution of images, audio, or video generated through information technologies, generative AI tools, or any digital means with the purpose of damaging the dignity, reputation, or safety of women, adolescents, and girls. Addresses documented cases of deepfakes, AI-manipulated content, and disinformation used to discredit female politicians and public figures. Seeks to close legal loopholes that allow impunity in digital political violence and ensure effective protection against new forms of technological aggression against women. Includes strengthening of coordination among educational, technology, and security authorities. Approved unanimously by the Comisión de Igualdad de Género (Gender Equality Commission) in November 2025, pending final vote in Pleno (plenary session).
